title: Relationship Pricing Schedule of Bonus Points Offered on Certificates of Deposit
content:
Two bonuses are published against the Certificates of Deposit line. Each is stated in percentage points, and each is added to both the interest rate and the annual percentage yield of a term.

## Jumbo bonus

| Tier | Jumbo bonus offered | Principal figure, USD | Bonus points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | no | 100000.00 | 0.00 |
| 12-Month Certificate | yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 36-Month Certificate | yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| 60-Month Certificate | yes | 100000.00 | 0.10 |

The 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate is the single tier on which the jumbo bonus is not offered, and its published bonus is accordingly 0.00 points.

## Relationship bonus

| Tier | Bonus points | Checking tiers the certificate treats as qualifying | Re-examined at each renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 0.10 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | yes |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0.05 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | yes |
| 12-Month Certificate | 0.15 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | yes |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 0.15 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | yes |
| 36-Month Certificate | 0.20 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | yes |
| 60-Month Certificate | 0.20 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | yes |

The qualifying tiers are tiers of the bank's Personal Checking line. The 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate recognises the narrower pair only; every other tier of the Certificates of Deposit line recognises Interest Checking as well.

## Reading the schedule

The tables give the size of each bonus and the holdings each tier recognises. Because both bonuses are quoted in percentage points, a tier offering 0.10 jumbo points and 0.20 relationship points offers 0.30 points where both are carried, and that sum is added alike to the rate and to the yield of the term.
